cover_letter:
Dear Go Vocal team,

I'm excited to apply for the Digital Marketer (Demand Gen / Growth Marketing) role. Your mission to make public decision-making more inclusive, participatory, and responsive speaks to me personally, and I'd love to contribute to your growth from startup to scale-up.

At Episto, I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and write keyword-targeted blog content to grow organic traffic. I build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, and track performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads. I also work in a CRM for a cleaning-services client, keeping customer records and follow-up up to date. This hands-on experience across SEO, content, web, and analytics has given me a full-funnel perspective.

On my own project, mirook.com, I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site and implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. I ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. This project reflects my curiosity for AI search visibility and my drive to ship and learn fast.

I'm eager to apply AI tools like n8n, Make, Zapier, and Claude to scale demand gen experiments and build automated workflows. I'm comfortable collaborating with agencies and cross-functional teams, and I thrive in autonomous, remote environments. Based in Belgium (CET), I'm ready to own the qualified pipeline KPI and experiment proactively.

I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills can support Go Vocal's mission and growth. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
